title: Codec search: learning rate, size and weight decay on validation links
description: Hyperparameter search for the codec (experiments/codec.py; docs/methodology.md): an encoder from one step's message to 16 ordered latents (nested dropout) and a decoder that predicts the flow's own smoothed RTT, delivery rate and loss 60 ms to 960 ms later from the latents and the window changes in between. Full grid: learning rate 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3; encoder width x depth 256x2, 256x4, 512x4 (decoder width equal, depth 2); weight decay 1e-4, 1e-2. Each run trains on 1,000,000 anchors drawn from the training links of release exp-phase0-steps-2 (links split 70/15/15, split seed 0), at most 25 epochs with cosine decay and early stopping, seed 0. The rule, fixed before the run: the setting with the lowest validation loss wins, where the loss averages over random prefixes of the latents, as in training. Scores are on validation links only; the test links are not read.
run: ARCH_W=${ARCH%x*}; ARCH_D=${ARCH#*x}; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/lr$LR-$ARCH-wd$WD" --data "$IN/steps" --set lr=$LR --set width=$ARCH_W --set depth=$ARCH_D --set dec_width=$ARCH_W --set weight_decay=$WD --set anchors=1000000 --set epochs=25 --set time_budget_s=9000
collect: uv run python experiments/codec_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/runs/*; find "$OUT/runs" -name model.pt -delete
